evidence: Homepage lists 8 heritage items ("共 8 个非遗项目") with image, title, English name, category tag, region, description and detail link for each: 春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂.
Clicking "了解详情" link for 春节 navigated to /heritage/spring-festival dedicated detail page; also clicking hotspot overlay's "查看详情" navigated to /heritage/suzhou-embroidery.
/heritage/suzhou-embroidery page shows title 苏绣, English name Suzhou Embroidery, category 传统工艺, region 江苏·江南水乡, inscription year 2006年入选, full long-form description, and 3 images with thumbnails.
Selecting category filter "传统工艺" reduced list from 8 to 2 items (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂), correctly filtering by category; other categories (传统表演, 民俗活动, 传统美术) also present and selectable.

After opening 苏绣 hotspot overlay in panorama, navigating to its detail page via "查看详情", then clicking "返回全景探索", the panorama view returned to /?view=panorama with the 苏绣 hotspot info overlay still open and showing identical content as before navigating away.

On panorama view load, a progress prompt "正在加载热点... (3/8)" is shown while hotspots load. On the 春节 detail page, the failed-to-load main image displayed fallback prompt "图片加载失败" with a broken-image icon.
Every listed item displays exactly one category tag: 春节/端午龙舟 = 民俗活动, 剪纸/书法 = 传统美术, 京剧/昆曲 = 传统表演, 苏绣/宜兴紫砂 = 传统工艺. Filtering by any of the 4 categories returns matching results.

Clicking a valid item's "了解详情" link or a panorama hotspot's "查看详情" link correctly navigates to its own /heritage/{slug} detail page (verified for spring-festival and suzhou-embroidery); no dead/invalid entries were found on the list to click.
Each list card and detail page includes title (Chinese+English), description paragraph, and region text (e.g. "北京 · 华夏大地", "江苏 · 江南水乡") for all 8 items checked.

List view shows a grid of cards with filter/sort controls, while detail view shows a distinct breadcrumb navigation, large hero image with thumbnail gallery, dedicated info panel, and "返回全景探索"/"浏览更多项目" actions — a clearly different layout/URL (/heritage/{slug} vs /) from the list.

All 8 featured items (春节 Spring Festival, 端午龙舟 Dragon Boat Racing, 剪纸 Paper Cutting, 京剧 Peking Opera, 昆曲 Kunqu Opera, 书法 Chinese Calligraphy, 苏绣 Suzhou Embroidery, 宜兴紫砂 Yixing Purple Clay) are genuine, well-known Chinese intangible cultural heritage entries with regions and 2006 UNESCO/national inscription info matching real historical facts.
